item.dynetech.shrunken_entity.tooltip.no: Alive, regrow with an Enlarge Disc
Left-click block: Corner A · Right-click block: Corner B · Right-click Shrinker: transfer
dynetech.microscope.empty: Insert a vial to inspect it.
dynetech.microscope.snapshot_body: Captured the donor's genome at the moment blood was drawn. Later injections do not update this record. Cannot be sequenced.
dynetech.microscope.pool_body: Every entry the sequencer might roll from a raw sample of this species. Weight influences the roll odds; higher weights are more likely to appear.
dynetech.perk.desc.micro: Shrinks the host toward half size via Pehkui.
dynetech.perk.desc.macro: Grows the host up to double size.
dynetech.perk.desc.longarm: Extends entity interaction range by up to +2.5 blocks.
dynetech.perk.desc.reachminer: Extends block interaction range by up to +2.5 blocks.
dynetech.perk.desc.hollowbones: Reduces gravity by up to 0.04 - lighter bones let you jump higher and drift down softly.
dynetech.perk.desc.grace: Grants Dolphin's Grace - huge underwater speed.
dynetech.perk.desc.invisibility: Chameleon: renders you semi-translucent instead of vanishing.
dynetech.perk.desc.absorption: Grants Absorption. Refreshes after 30 seconds at full health.
dynetech.perk.desc.photosynthesis: Heals slowly in direct sunlight when well-fed.
dynetech.perk.desc.bloodthirst: Heals for 35% of dealt melee damage.
dynetech.perk.desc.cactus_skin: Reflects 40% of melee damage back at the attacker.
dynetech.perk.desc.explosive_death: Explodes on death - radius scales with quality.
dynetech.perk.desc.ignition_defect: Bursts into flame at random intervals. Higher quality = more often.
dynetech.perk.desc.frailty_defect: Constant Weakness. Melee attacks deal less damage.
dynetech.perk.desc.starvation_defect: Constant Hunger. Food bar drains faster.
dynetech.perk.desc.withering_defect: Constant Wither. Health slowly ticks down.
dynetech.perk.desc.photophobia_defect: Takes damage in direct sunlight. A carved pumpkin blocks it.
dynetech.perk.desc.gluttony_defect: Hunger drains far faster than normal.
dynetech.perk.desc.screamer_defect: Aggros nearby hostile mobs onto the host every few seconds.
dynetech.perk.desc.static_defect: Draws lightning strikes every few seconds when caught outdoors during a thunderstorm.
dynetech.perk.desc.vertigo_defect: Nausea sets in whenever a ledge dropping more than 3 blocks is within 5 blocks.
dynetech.perk.desc.dud: No effect. Player self-samples always sequence into duds.
dynetech.condition.desc.sneaking: Only expresses while the host is crouched.
dynetech.condition.desc.sprinting: Only expresses while the host is sprinting.
dynetech.condition.desc.not_moving: Only expresses while the host stands still.
dynetech.condition.desc.falling: Only expresses while the host is airborne after falling.
dynetech.condition.desc.on_fire: Only expresses while the host is on fire.
dynetech.condition.desc.low_health: Only expresses when the host is below 50% health.
dynetech.condition.desc.high_health: Only expresses when the host is at or above 90% health.
dynetech.condition.desc.using_item: Only expresses while the host is using an item.
dynetech.condition.desc.alone: Only expresses when no other players are within 16 blocks.
dynetech.sequencer.hint: Insert a Raw Sample vial, then use Empty vials to isolate perks.
dynetech.splicer.hint: Insert two vials - two Isolated to merge, or Isolated + Empty to brew a Serum.
item.dynetech.injection_gun.hint: Sneak + Right-click to load / eject a vial from the off-hand
item.dynetech.injection_gun.punch_hint: Attack a mob to sample or inject · Sneak + attack to target yourself
item.dynetech.injection_gun.load_hint: Off-hand needs an Empty or Serum vial to load; empty off-hand to eject
item.dynetech.perk_cycler.hint: Right-click to strip all perks and apply the next one in the registry.
dynetech.inject.incompatible: Serum rejected — target does not match the blood's donor.
